how: An initial character proposal recruits help but receives a location question rather than a visible commitment to build.
An original builder defends the chosen black background for contrast while other participants favour changing it to purple.
Reports of an existing heart and a Steam group guide establish visible reporting and maintenance without establishing that this subreddit directed construction.
Repeated requests and coordinate answers make the existing picture findable to participants after it is already standing.
Members preserve the logo through repair commitments, repeated fixes and requests to undo attempts to change its lettering.
A participant attributes a stray blue pixel to their own uninformed placement.
The purple negotiator explicitly withdraws pressure to recolour the background after a builder asks to retain black.
Participants negotiate permission to recolour the background while promising to protect the logo and eventually accept the builders' refusal.
The surviving title calls for converting an existing heart into the KS logo without establishing that the proposed conversion happened.
Pointing to an already existing heart does not establish rebuilding or relocation after losing a mark.
Members celebrate the surviving heart and thank its defenders after placement ends.
A participant locates the yellow heart in the visual record and reports that it remained until the end.
Celebration and retrospective discovery provide no observed decision to continue the canvas effort or retain its organisation.
One participant reports using four accounts to preserve the image without demonstrating scripts or a dispute over automation.
A short offer to lend pixels assents to the purple proposal without requesting anything in return.
Protection is offered in exchange for recolouring permission, but the record supports a proposed bargain rather than delivered reciprocal help.
A personal preservation list and an offered protection bargain do not establish coalition membership.
The Swedish reply naming its community supplies one opposing turn to the heart conversion call without establishing a prolonged contest.
A request to change the background does not establish that the logo lived on another community's territory under its rule.
Discussion of Reddit styling does not establish a host restriction on canvas posts or an objection to their volume.
Participants hesitate to consent for others before an original builder states the builders' preference and acknowledges limited control during sleep.
Reporting survival and questioning its explanation do not establish a dispute over cleanup or which account should be preserved.
An outside community's April Fools redesign can enter host discussion without demonstrating a host takeover or that its canvas calls were jokes.
An individual's competing placement commitments do not establish that the host judged its collective strength inadequate.
The sports projects cited by a declining participant do not establish an inherited quarrel belonging to the host community.
Proposals draw on familiar characters as canvas marks without demonstrating a colour doctrine or historical rivalry.
An official guide and builder preferences leave the unseen Steam group's leadership, votes, sanctions and division of labour unresolved.
A member's sports commitments explain declining the canvas call without establishing a prior rivalry adopted by the host community.
A proposed picture establishes an initiator but cannot identify the surviving heart's starter without evidence connecting proposal, joining and construction.
Making a proposal in the host thread does not establish carrying it between threads or chats.
A call followed by a report of an existing heart does not establish that the call produced its construction.
Proposal and recruitment can occur within one call, so separate starter and mobilisation stages cannot be presumed locally.
Maintenance of an existing heart is visible while the transition from its construction remains outside the demonstrated sequence.
The purple request names prior displacement elsewhere rather than demonstrating that erosion of the KS logo caused negotiation.
A builder's stated refusal of recolouring receives an explicit promise not to push the proposed change.
Four accounts are expressly used for integrity but insufficient manual capacity causing their adoption is not established.
Celebration concerns a standing image without establishing the missing build history or its causal relationship to the celebration.
Crediting defenders and reporting endurance can be intertwined in one retrospective exchange rather than demonstrating celebration causing a subsequent recording step.
Reports of the final image do not show a subsequent decision to carry the effort into another purpose or venue.
An individual decline and an existing heart's coordinates establish neither collective inadequacy nor a resulting relocation.
Design disputes can be settled by a builder's refusal and a visitor's withdrawal rather than by circulating a new template.
A recruitment call can receive a request for missing coordinates instead of a bare commitment, leaving silent acceptance untestable.
The offered protection bargain does not show a shortage of defenders causing a request for outside help.
Negotiating offered protection need not produce enacted reciprocity when the requested colour concession is refused.
Recruitment and an attack proposal can be the same utterance without demonstrating that earlier mobilisation caused a later attack.
A reasoned refusal of an attack call can allocate effort elsewhere without expressing a norm of restraint or fear of retaliation.
Coordinate redirects answering the conversion call do not establish an invoked truce or a proposed deal.
The heart conversion call receives an opposing Swedish response naming its community without demonstrating that conversion occurred.
Maintaining a logo and listing preservation projects do not demonstrate joining a coalition in response to attack.
Recruitment calls are visible without an observed resulting flood, megathread or change to host posting rules.
A proposed agreement can expose uncertainty over who may consent before any treaty exists or any member rejects its binding force.
A participant brings an already followed official guide back from an outside organising group while reporting current maintenance.
Admitting one's own uninformed placement does not demonstrate anyone mistaking friendly construction for vandalism.
Admiring and joking about another community's prank redesign is local conduct even when the host stages no demonstrated takeover.
Seeking permission and a maker's help to import another community's prank styling extends host framing beyond retaining changes already installed locally.
Wanting another community's template and suggesting help establish a prospective transfer rather than installation or retention after April Fools.
Participants can consider rival explanations for survival, including obscurity and fondness, without resolving them or attributing the outcome conclusively to defence.
Warnings to avoid the neighbouring blue block advise restraint based on its sensitivity without establishing a treaty with it.
A bare thank you acknowledges a coordinate answer without proving subsequent pixel placement.
